# Nyale Commissions

> Official portfolio and commission information for Nyale, a digital artist and animator also known as Nyalefox, Nyalexandre, and "Desenhando com Nyale".

Canonical website: https://alexandre0202.github.io/NyalexandreWiki/
The website is primarily written in English. The artist is based in Brazil and uses the Portuguese identity phrase "Desenhando com Nyale".

## Main pages

- [Home and artist overview](https://alexandre0202.github.io/NyalexandreWiki/): Artist introduction, featured artwork, social links, and commission overview.
- [Portfolio](https://alexandre0202.github.io/NyalexandreWiki/portifolio.html): Artwork gallery, commissions, and personal pieces.
- [Art styles](https://alexandre0202.github.io/NyalexandreWiki/arttypes.html): Available illustration and animation styles.
- [Pricing](https://alexandre0202.github.io/NyalexandreWiki/pricing.html): Commission types, prices, extras, and options.
- [YCH commissions](https://alexandre0202.github.io/NyalexandreWiki/YCH.html): Your Character Here examples, slots, and instructions.
- [How to order](https://alexandre0202.github.io/NyalexandreWiki/order.html): Commission process and order form.

## Artist and topics

- Artist names: Nyale, Nyalefox, Nyalexandre, Desenhando com Nyale.
- Work: digital illustration, pony art, furry art, YCH commissions, pixel art, animation, character art, and Telegram stickers.
